Use these commands (run as an admin with appropriate CLI credentials):

GitHub (remove direct repo collaborator)
- Using gh CLI:
  gh api -X DELETE /repos/acme/billing-service/collaborators/marcus
- Or with curl (replace $GITHUB_TOKEN with a token that has admin:org/repo scope):
  curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
    https://api.github.com/repos/acme/billing-service/collaborators/marcus

AWS IAM (remove from prod-deployers group)
  aws iam remove-user-from-group --user-name marcus --group-name prod-deployers

One-line audit note for the ticket:
2026-09-03 — Removed GitHub write access for user "marcus" on acme/billing-service and removed him from AWS IAM group "prod-deployers" per Legal offboarding approval.
